name: Hero recipe with full history, verified reduced original data
authorization: User requested launch of the contracted selection and W&B train/validation loss comparisons.
initialization: Fresh raw BT4 plus original seed-0 auxiliary modules; no continuation from Hero1
history: Full current and future LC0 history; retain standard and Chess960 roots

data.selection: Original seed-0 first-554-shard order, remove only frozen unresolved-history rows, then take first 566272 surviving rows; no repeats or substitutes
data.validation_selection: Original ascending fast pool, remove frozen 8 unresolved rows, take first 8128 surviving positions

optimizer.schedule: Original example-count cosine; not rescaled to the short run

logging.train: Every update: raw metrics JSONL and W&B; graph by examples and updates
logging.components: Full recorded DFM, JEPA, SIGReg, legality and WDL metrics; do not compare train and validation totals as identical estimators
logging.wandb: Online only with a supplied Modal secret; otherwise offline files persisted for later sync
logging.historical_train_curve: Import original Hero1 curve, explicitly labelled non-matched training batches
logging.historical_validation_curve: Reevaluate available original Hero1 checkpoints 100,200,300,400,500,554 on identical retained validation rows and RNG seed, with history zeroed to match their training
logging.comparison_limit: Different training subset, batching and terminal step; descriptive comparison, not causal history-only ablation. JEPA targets themselves change with history; compare policy CE/accuracy separately.

retention: Final model-only checkpoint and update-500/final recovery states; compact evidence and W&B files. No deletions.

budget.rule: Fresh live usage plus conservative previous-attempt floor; complete CPU verification before GPU allocation. No search or arenas in this attempt.
